$comment: 牌阵配置。positions 按抽牌顺序排列；x / y 是揭示时的格位（以牌宽为单位，0,0 为中心，y 向下为正，可以是小数、可以不对称）；cross=true 表示这张横放压在同一格的牌上（凯尔特十字第 2 张，只是摆法，和逆位无关）。home=false 的牌阵不出现在首页的三个按钮里，而在「更多牌阵」里；menu=false 的不出现在任何选择列表里。links 是解读面板里「牌与牌之间」要对照看的位置；questions 是留给用户的开放式反思问题；note 是原创牌阵的说明。

sub.zh: 每日一张 · 今日的提醒
sub.en: One card a day · today's reminder

meaning.en: A theme worth noticing today.

questions.zh: 今天，你想把哪一个词带在身上？
questions.en: Which one word would you like to carry with you today?

sub.zh: 一张牌 · 此刻的启示
sub.en: One card · A message for now

meaning.zh: 当下的指引或值得反思的主题。
meaning.en: Guidance for now, or a theme to reflect on.

questions.zh: 这张牌最先让你注意到的是什么？
questions.en: What did you notice first on this card?

questions.zh: 它让你想起最近的哪件事？
questions.en: Which recent moment does it bring to mind?

sub.zh: 三张牌 · 过去 / 现在 / 未来

meaning.en: Background and lingering influences.
Where things stand now.

meaning.zh: 可能的发展方向，而不是必然的结果。
meaning.en: A possible direction — not a fixed outcome.

text.zh: 看看过去留下的东西，怎样变成了现在的样子。
text.en: Notice how what came before has turned into how things are now.

text.zh: 如果现在的状态继续下去，它可能把你带向这里——方向仍然可以调整。
text.en: If things continue as they are, they may lead here — the direction can still be adjusted.

questions.zh: 过去的哪一部分，你愿意带着走？哪一部分可以放下？
questions.en: Which part of the past do you want to carry on, and which can you set down?

questions.zh: 如果未来只是可能之一，你希望往哪个方向推一点？
questions.en: If the future is only one possibility, which way would you nudge it?

sub.zh: 五张牌 · 处境与指引

meaning.en: Where you are right now.
What is holding you back.
Strength you can draw on.
A direction worth trying.

meaning.zh: 顺着现在走下去可能出现的样子，而不是定数。
meaning.en: Where things may lead if they continue — not a certainty.

text.zh: 处境与阻碍：卡住你的，往往就长在现状里面。
text.en: Situation and obstacle: what holds you back often grows out of where you are.

text.zh: 处境与助力：现状里也藏着可以借用的力量。
text.en: Situation and support: where you are also holds strength you can borrow.

text.zh: 阻碍与助力放在一起看：它们有时是同一件事的两面。
text.en: Obstacle and support side by side: sometimes they are two sides of the same thing.

text.zh: 建议与可能的发展：试着照建议走一步，发展的样子也会跟着变。
text.en: Advice and potential: take one step with the advice, and the potential shifts with it.

questions.zh: 阻碍和助力之间，有没有其实是同一件事的两面？
questions.en: Are the obstacle and the support perhaps two sides of one thing?

questions.zh: 建议那张牌，今天可以落实成哪个小动作？
questions.en: What small action today could the advice card become?

sub.zh: 七张牌 · 来路与去向
sub.en: Seven cards · Where you came from, where it may go

meaning.en: The road behind that still shapes you.
Where you stand now.

meaning.zh: 还没被看清、却在起作用的东西。
meaning.en: What is at work beneath notice.
The knot most worth facing.
The people and circumstances around you.
A direction worth trying.

meaning.zh: 顺着现在走下去可能的样子，而不是定数。
meaning.en: Where this may lead — not a certainty.

text.zh: 来路与此刻：过去留下的痕迹，正以现在的样子出现。
text.en: Road and present: what the past left behind now shows up as the present.

text.zh: 潜在影响与阻碍：卡住你的，可能是还没被看见的东西。
text.en: Hidden influence and obstacle: what blocks you may be what hasn't been seen yet.

text.zh: 外部环境与建议：建议往往要放在身边的处境里才走得通。
text.en: Surroundings and advice: advice works best when it fits the world around you.

text.zh: 阻碍与可能结果：怎样对待阻碍，会改变结局的样子。
text.en: Obstacle and outcome: how you meet the obstacle changes the shape of what follows.

questions.zh: 潜在影响那张牌，是不是你一直没说出口的东西？
questions.en: Is the hidden-influence card something you have never said out loud?

questions.zh: 如果只改变一件事，你会从阻碍下手，还是从建议下手？
questions.en: If you changed only one thing, would you start from the obstacle or from the advice?

sub.zh: 十张牌 · 全面看一件事
sub.en: Ten cards · A full look at one matter

meaning.en: Where things stand.

meaning.zh: 横在面前的力量，可能是阻碍，也可能是推动。
meaning.en: The force across your path — a block, or a push.

meaning.zh: 事情的基础，或潜意识里的东西。
meaning.en: The ground beneath it, or what lies below awareness.
An influence now passing.

meaning.zh: 你有意识在追求或在意的目标。
meaning.en: What you consciously aim for or care about.

meaning.zh: 不久之后可能出现的变化。
meaning.en: A change that may come soon.

meaning.zh: 你怎样看待自己在其中的位置。
meaning.en: How you see your own place in it.
The influence of others and surroundings.

meaning.zh: 你期待的，和你害怕的——有时是同一件事。
meaning.en: What you hope for and what you fear — sometimes the same thing.

meaning.zh: 顺着现在走下去可能的样子，而不是定数。
meaning.en: Where this may lead — not a certainty.

text.zh: 现状与横跨其上的挑战：这是整副牌阵的中心交叉。
text.en: Situation and the challenge crossing it: the heart of the whole spread.

text.zh: 根基与意识：心里真正驱动你的，和你以为自己想要的，一样吗？
text.en: Foundation and conscious aim: is what truly drives you the same as what you think you want?

text.zh: 过去与近期发展：一股影响正在离开，另一股正在靠近。
text.en: Past and near future: one influence leaving, another arriving.

text.zh: 自我态度与外部环境：你怎么看自己，和别人怎么影响你。
text.en: Self and environment: how you see yourself, and how others shape you.

text.zh: 希望与恐惧、可能结果：期待与担心，都会悄悄改变结局。
text.en: Hopes & fears and outcome: both expectation and worry quietly bend the ending.

questions.zh: 意识里想要的，和根基里真正驱动你的，一样吗？
questions.en: Is what you consciously want the same as what drives you underneath?

questions.zh: 希望与恐惧那张牌，哪一面更像你现在的感觉？
questions.en: Which side of the hopes-and-fears card feels closer to you now?

questions.zh: 可能的结果里，有多少是你还能改变的？
questions.en: How much of the possible outcome is still yours to change?

sub.zh: 三张牌 · 面具、阴影与自性

note.zh: 原创牌阵：借用荣格的概念作反思的比喻，不是心理测评。
note.en: An original spread that borrows Jungian ideas as metaphors for reflection — not a psychological assessment.

meaning.en: The face you show the world.

meaning.zh: 被你藏起、或不愿承认的部分。
meaning.en: What you hide, or would rather not own.

meaning.zh: 把两者都包含进来的、更完整的你。
meaning.en: A fuller you that holds both.

text.zh: 面具与阴影：一个被展示，一个被藏起，它们常常互为镜像。
text.en: Persona and shadow: one shown, one hidden — often each other's mirror.

text.zh: 阴影与自性：被接纳的阴影，会成为完整的一部分。
text.en: Shadow and self: a shadow that is accepted becomes part of the whole.

questions.zh: 别人眼中的你，和你心里的自己，差在哪里？
questions.en: Where do the you others see and the you inside differ?

questions.zh: 阴影那张牌里，有没有你其实需要的力量？
questions.en: Is there a strength you actually need inside the shadow card?

sub.zh: 五张牌 · 两条路的得与失
sub.en: Five cards · What each path gives and takes

note.zh: 原创牌阵：把两个选项摊开来看，不替你做决定。
note.en: An original spread that lays two options side by side — it does not choose for you.

meaning.zh: 做选择时你所在的位置。
meaning.en: Where you stand as you choose.

meaning.zh: 选 A 可能得到的。
meaning.en: What path A may give.

meaning.zh: 选 A 可能付出的。
meaning.en: What path A may cost.

meaning.zh: 选 B 可能得到的。
meaning.en: What path B may give.

meaning.zh: 选 B 可能付出的。
meaning.en: What path B may cost.

text.zh: A 的得与失：这条路给你的，和它要你放下的。
text.en: Path A, gain and cost: what it offers, and what it asks you to let go.

text.zh: B 的得与失：这条路给你的，和它要你放下的。
text.en: Path B, gain and cost: what it offers, and what it asks you to let go.

text.zh: 两种代价放在一起：你更愿意承担哪一种？
text.en: The two costs side by side: which would you rather carry?

questions.zh: 如果两条路都没有标准答案，你更愿意承担哪一种代价？
questions.en: If neither path is the right answer, which cost would you rather bear?

questions.zh: 做这个选择时，你最怕失去的是什么？
questions.en: In this choice, what are you most afraid to lose?

sub.zh: 六张牌 · 一段关系里的你和对方
sub.en: Six cards · You and the other in a relationship

note.zh: 原创牌阵：「对方」只代表你眼中的对方，牌不能读出别人的真实想法。
note.en: An original spread: 'the other' is only the other as you see them — cards cannot read another person's mind.

meaning.zh: 你在这段关系里真正需要的。
meaning.en: What you truly need in this relationship.
The other, as you see them.
What you share.
Where you rub against each other.
How things could be said.
One thing you could do first.

text.zh: 我的需要与我眼中的对方：你看见的，也带着你自己的影子。
text.en: My needs and the other as I see them: what you see carries your own shadow too.

text.zh: 冲突与沟通：摩擦的地方，也是最需要说清楚的地方。
text.en: Friction and communication: where you rub is where clarity is most needed.

text.zh: 共同基础与行动：从你们都有的东西出发，迈出第一步。
text.en: Common ground and next step: start from what you both share.

questions.zh: 你的需要，有没有被清楚地说出来过？
questions.en: Has your need ever been said clearly?

questions.zh: 沟通那张牌，可以变成下一次对话里的哪一句话？
questions.en: Which sentence in your next conversation could the communication card become?

questions.zh: 这些只是你眼中的对方；真正的答案，要问他本人。
questions.en: This is only the other as you see them; the real answer lies with them.
